**DS066** is a medical diagnosis code designating traumatic subarachnoid hemorrhage. Within the Danish healthcare system, it serves as a critical data point for monitoring patient safety and treatment outcomes, specifically within the national clinical quality database for [[atrieflimren]] managed by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP). 

The primary significance of DS066 lies in its use as a quality indicator for anticoagulation therapy. Because patients with atrial fibrillation are often prescribed blood thinners, they carry a heightened risk of bleeding complications. To measure the safety of these treatments, RKKP tracks the incidence of [[intrakraniel-bloedning|Intrakraniel blødning]] among prevalent patients. DS066 is one of the specific ICD-10-DK codes used to identify these events, alongside [[di60|DI60]], [[di61|DI61]], [[di62|DI62]], [[ds064|DS064]], and [[ds065|DS065]] [^src1]. 

Beyond intracranial events, DS066 is also incorporated into a broader composite indicator that measures the incidence of severe bleeding overall. In this context, it is grouped with a wide array of other diagnostic codes that capture gastrointestinal bleeding (such as [[dk25-0|DK25.0]] through [[dk29-8a|DK29.8A]] and [[dk92-0|DK92.0]] through [[dk92-2|DK92.2]]) and urinary/respiratory bleeding (including [[dj942|DJ942]], [[dn02|DN02]], [[dr04|DR04]], and [[dr31|DR31]]) [^src1]. By standardizing these codes, the RKKP ensures consistent data collection across Danish regions, enabling precise comparisons of treatment safety, such as evaluating the bleeding risks associated with DOACs versus Marevan across different CHA2DS2-VASc risk profiles.
